hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.DiskAttachment.description: DiskAttachment is how a disk is attached, as the spec of the machine listing it says.

as.description:
DiskAttachmentRole is what a machine uses a disk as.

- DISK_ATTACHMENT_ROLE_BOOT: The disk a VM boots from.
- DISK_ATTACHMENT_ROLE_DATA: A block device given to the guest as it is.
- DISK_ATTACHMENT_ROLE_VOLUME: A filesystem a container mounts.

device.description: The disk's place in the order the hypervisor attaches disks, as a Linux guest names virtio disks, such as "vdc".

kind.description: The kind and name of what the machine was made from, in the disk's project, such as Container "web".

path.description: Where a VOLUME is mounted in the guest, as the container's spec has it.

readOnly.description: Whether a VOLUME is mounted read-only.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.DiskSource.description: DiskSource is what a disk is made from. Leaving it empty makes a blank disk, all zeros.

image.description:
A copy of an image, grown to the disk's size, which must be at least the image's status.disk_size.

Set at most one of image.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.DiskSpec.description: DiskSpec is the desired state of a disk.

size.description: A quantity in whole Gi, such as "20Gi", at least 1Gi; a size that is not whole Gi is rounded up. It can grow but never shrink. A machine sees a disk grown while it runs once it boots again.

source.description: What the disk holds when it is made.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.DiskStatus.description: DiskStatus is the observed state of a disk. The apiserver writes its node, size, machine, attachment, phase and the Allocated condition; the disk's node writes the Ready and Released conditions.

attachment.description: What the disk is attached to and used as; unset when it is attached to none. See docs/decisions/container-volumes.md.

machine.description: Names the Machine, in the disk's project, the disk is attached to; empty when it is attached to none. As attachment.machine.

node.description: Names the Node the disk lives on. Empty until a machine using it is placed; once set it never changes.

phase.description:
DiskPhase is where a disk is in its lifecycle.

- DISK_PHASE_PENDING: Not yet made on a node: no machine has used it, or its node is making it.
- DISK_PHASE_AVAILABLE: Made on its node and attached to no machine.
- DISK_PHASE_IN_USE: Attached to a machine.

size.description: The size the disk has on its node, in whole Gi: spec.size once its node has room for it, and never less than before.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.ImageSource.description: ImageSource names the Image a disk is copied from. See docs/decisions/vm-images.md.

description: Disk is a durable block device in a project. It lives on one node, the one that ran the first machine it was attached to, and outlives the machines it is attached to, one at a time. See docs/decisions/machine-model.md and docs/decisions/storage-zfs.md.
title: Disk
